facts.claim: The death of Bro. Agnew, a member of the Lodge and P.M. of Lodge Bangalore, was reported.
facts.quote: The news was received of the death of Bro. Agnew, a member of the Lodge and P. M. of Lodge Bangalore.

facts.claim: The Lodge decided to observe a month of mourning and hold a Lodge of sorrow.
facts.quote: It was resolved to put the Lodge into mourning for a month and to hold a Lodge of sorrow.

facts.claim: Rs. 50 was sanctioned to the widow of a Bro. Mason who had arrived at the station, fallen ill, and died before joining the Lodge.
facts.quote: Rs. 50 was also sanctioned to the widow of a Bro. Mason who had recently arrived in the Station, but had been taken ill and had died before he could join the Lodge.
